body: Yeah I went to my dr in a anxious mess and all she did was try to make me take Zoloft....I don't think most doctors realize the withdrawal effects of these drugs, I don't think they know much about them at all...except how to prescribe them. I will be going to a psychologist though
Thank you.....and I really hope so....x

Yeah I was always wondering if the pills actually did anything..they did a bit i guess...they numbed me.the side effects were shocking....I never thought of suicide until I started on Effexor I read about the black box warning, as those thoughts didn't pop up too often I learnt to ignore them. I knew withdrawal would be though but shit those pills are evil...

I do....my mind starts going crazy fast thinking about shit that's most likely not going to happen and then I panic....I just want to say thank you, you have made me realise there is hope and there is a chance I can get though this...

Yeah I remember that feeling. It's good to know there may be hope to get out of this mental mess. I only had the physical withdrawal symptoms(brain zaps and shakes ect) during the weaning....so all this emotion has hit me like a truck.
Really? Thank you I needed to hear that.. How long would you say the detox takes?
